Generate a structured daily site progress report from unstructured input such as voice transcription, rough notes, or conversational messages.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Easily generate professional daily construction site reports from informal input.

- Converts rough notes, voice transcriptions, or chats into structured, filing-ready daily reports.
- Automatically organises content into 13 required sections (e.g., header, workforce, work completed, safety, delays).
- Always asks the user for missing critical information such as weather, workforce count, work completed, safety, and delays.
- Uses industry-standard terminology and report format suitable for construction documentation.
- Guides users with follow-up questions and review prompts before finalising reports.
